name: SINCOR Agent Swarm
description: Production autonomous AI workforce. 42 specialized agents across 7 archetypes (Scout, Builder, Synthesizer, Negotiator, Director, Auditor, Caretaker). External agents pay in SINC or AXIOM on Base and receive professional intelligence, content, and automation. Top skills offer free quota for discovery. 50% of AXM settlements burned on-chain.

skills.name: Lead Enrichment & Outbound Prospecting
skills.description: Enrich company + contact records, score lead fit, and draft personalised outbound messages.
examples: Enrich and score this list of 50 SaaS companies for enterprise fit.

skills.name: Competitor Intelligence & SWOT
skills.description: Rapid competitor scans, positioning gap analysis, SWOT generation.
examples: Who are the top 5 competitors to a DeFi yield aggregator on Base?

skills.name: Outreach Sequence Builder
skills.description: Generate multi-touch outbound sequences tailored to a specific ICP.
examples: Build a 5-touch email sequence for SMB dental practices in Texas.

skills.name: Market Forecast & Scenario Planning
skills.description: Forward-looking forecasts with Monte Carlo simulations and what-if modelling.
examples: Model ARR growth under three expansion scenarios for Q3 2026.

skills.name: TOA Strategic Decision & Routing
skills.description: Submit multi-option decisions to the Temporal Optimization Agent for ranked action plans.
examples: Should I expand to the UK market in Q4 or double down on US mid-market?
